known_limitation: Codex subagents supplied preliminary fixed-source proposals. The primary experiment lead independently checked every registered source occurrence and signed all final verdicts before any v3 reviewer-route output existed.

items.reason: The fixed dialogue context confirms a recommendation to return to Irkkk; the destination, action and tone are preserved.
The orb controls the training room and its facilities; the target preserves that function and all markup. 'Training facilities' would only be a wording refinement.
The fixed condition and log describe advanced mastery training; praise, mastery and stronger energy flows are all preserved.
Both journal entries preserve the people, places, intelligence, orc threat, speculation, chronology, markup and paragraph structure.
In the persuasion branch the line is a reluctant acceptance; the Chinese elliptical response retains that stance. Any awkwardness is fluency, not an objective defect.
All six matches were reviewed. Five are the shared lore category and one is an embedded phrase; each denotes the same infinite-dungeon concept and supports the target.

The ancestry, necromancer, two disasters, repeated returns and closing irony are preserved. 法术大爆炸 is inconsistent with the usual 魔法大爆炸, but no frozen general event-name terminology contract applies to this item, so it remains a consistency recommendation rather than an objective defect.
The title is emitted when recharge cost exceeds the player's money; the target accurately states insufficient funds.

Names, facts, placeholders and markup are preserved. One source single-line break between adjacent prose sentences is reflowed without losing a paragraph boundary, token or Chinese word; this is permissible localization layout, not an objective format defect.
Selecting the answer immediately spawns and accepts the chest, so the performative Chinese completion accurately reflects the action.
The narrator's identity, persecution, rescue, induced attribution, injuries and antimagic exhortation are all preserved without turning her bias into objective narration.
Name, dates, three epitaph meanings, final death reversal, markup and line structure are retained. Loss of the coined-word parallelism is a literary-style loss outside the objective-defect scope.
The adjacent embrace and promise make the thought a future reunion and affection; the Chinese wording retains that sustaining thought, future journey, kiss action and markup.
Wyrmic, Wilder, Equilibrium, stamina and elemental abilities follow the frozen terms; list structure, markup and the failure-and-lost-turn mechanism are preserved.
This is a letter title referring to the character The Master; the frozen entity name 领主 and recipient relation are correct.
The target idiomatically preserves the commitment in 'count on me', and Protector is correctly named.
The frozen entity name is Assassin Lord=盗贼领主, and the ownership threat is preserved exactly in meaning.
All seven matches were reviewed. Four are translated escort headings and three are embedded identifiers; every applicable branch supports the escort meaning.
Colour markup, line structure, the dying speaker, past counterfactual and denial of mercy are all preserved.
Series name, chapter number and Into Darkness meaning are preserved; alternative literary phrasing is only stylistic.
The option opens the weapon's basic-property adjustment interface; the target accurately describes that action.
Both training choices, category/talent roles and 50/8-gold costs match the fixed menu actions. Omission of the word 'basic' is not a material semantic omission in this training phrasing.
The answer immediately changes level to the destination; the bracketed teleport action is accurate and structurally preserved.
The file-hash-bound Cults dialogue is an undead player's retort; the target accurately asks whether the device has never seen an undead and does not contain the old invented aggression.
The action attacks Krogar and the frozen entity name is 克罗加尔; both target and runtime object agree.
Per-turn nature damage, seven turns, healing reduction and removal of one random detrimental magical effect match the implementation; both format arguments retain count, type and order.
All three dates, investigation progression, elemental geometry, warped crystals, alien fear/malice and the destroyed-crystal inference are preserved with markup intact.
The character asks the player to follow and the action enters the arena; the bracketed target accurately states that action.
All three matches were reviewed. Two are standalone farewell answers and one is a substring in a longer refusal; every context supports the same goodbye meaning.
The player asks for the alchemist's proposal after hearing the risk; added hesitation is a tone choice without an objective meaning change.
This is the player's thanks after Elisa's identification service; gratitude and the proper name are correct.
Welcome, place, request for brevity and precious time are preserved, and @playername@ remains byte-identical.

The production target contains a literal line feed inside the Chinese word 包裹 and extra paragraph breaks absent from the source. The split word is an objective visible-format defect; acceptable wording choices such as 报告 versus 消息 are not included in this finding.

finding.problem: A hard line feed splits one Chinese word between characters in the stored target and can render as a visibly broken word.
finding.correction: Keep 包裹 contiguous and remove the unmotivated extra hard paragraph breaks while preserving @playername@ and #GOLD# markup.
